import asyncio
from typing import Any

import httpx
from fastmcp import FastMCP
from fastmcp.server.openapi import OpenAPIProvider


def create_openapi_mcp_server(
    openapi_spec: dict[str, Any],
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    server_name: str = "OpenAPI Server",
) -> FastMCP:
    """
    Generate an MCP server from an OpenAPI 3.0 specification.
    
    Args:
        openapi_spec: OpenAPI 3.0 specification as a Python dict
        client: Configured httpx.AsyncClient with base URL
        server_name: Optional name for the MCP server
        
    Returns:
        FastMCP server with tools mirroring OpenAPI operations
    """
    provider = OpenAPIProvider(openapi_spec=openapi_spec, client=client)
    server = FastMCP(server_name)
    server.add_provider(provider)
    return server


async def main():
    # Example minimal OpenAPI 3.0 spec
    openapi_spec = {
        "openapi": "3.0.0",
        "info": {"title": "Example API", "version": "1.0.0"},
        "paths": {
            "/users": {
                "get": {
                    "operationId": "listUsers",
                    "summary": "List all users",
                    "responses": {"200": {"description": "Success"}},
                }
            },
            "/users/{id}": {
                "get": {
                    "operationId": "getUser",
                    "summary": "Get a specific user",
                    "parameters": [
                        {
                            "name": "id",
                            "in": "path",
                            "required": True,
                            "schema": {"type": "string"},
                        }
                    ],
                    "responses": {"200": {"description": "Success"}},
                }
            },
        },
    }

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url="https://api.example.com") as client:
        server = create_openapi_mcp_server(openapi_spec, client)
        
        # List all available tools
        tools = server.list_tools()
        print(f"Generated {len(tools)} tools from OpenAPI spec:")
        for tool in tools:
            print(f"  - {tool.name}: {tool.description}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
